description: In the Virtualmin control panel (accessible at https://localhost:10000, login: root / GymAnything123!), create a new email mailbox for the domain 'acmecorp.test'. The new email account should have the following details: username 'john.smith', real name 'John Smith', email address 'john.smith@acmecorp.test', and password 'JohnSmith789!'. Navigate to the acmecorp.test virtual server in the left panel, then go to 'Edit Users' (or 'Add a User to this Server') and fill in the form to create the mailbox.
